---
title: "noaa_flexdashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```


```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

set.seed(1)
ny_noaa_clean =
  ny_noaa |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  drop_na() |>
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day")) |>
  mutate(
     prcp = prcp / 10,
     tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
     tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(year == 2010, !is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |> 
  sample_n(2000) # Random sampling 
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A: Temperature Trends (Scatter Plot)

```{r}
ny_noaa_clean |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~month, alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart B: Distribution of Max Temperatures by Month (Box Plot)

```{r}
ny_noaa_clean |> 
  mutate(month = factor(month, labels = month.abb)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    y = ~tmax, x = ~month, color = ~month, 
    type = "box", colors = "Set3"
  ) %>% 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Max Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Chart C: Total Weather Observations by Station (Bar Plot)

```{r}
ny_noaa_clean |> 
  count(id) |> 
  filter(n > 15) |> 
  mutate(id = fct_reorder(id, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~id, y = ~n, color = ~id, 
    type = "bar", colors = "viridis"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Station ID", showticklabels = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Observation Count")
  )
```
